task_metadata.research_topic: architecture design for climate physics emulation
task_metadata.research_question: Design an improved neural network architecture for emulating sub-grid atmospheric physics processes in climate models.
notes: Task is grounded in the ClimSim benchmark and its benchmark-derived baseline models.

tests.label: short-10ep
tests.notes: 10-epoch training-budget evaluation from the ClimSim benchmark task.

tests.label: medium-30ep
tests.notes: 30-epoch training-budget evaluation from the ClimSim benchmark task.

tests.label: long-60ep
tests.notes: 60-epoch training-budget evaluation from the ClimSim benchmark task.

baselines.name: cnn
baselines.notes: Profile CNN baseline from ClimSim, with a close explicit subgrid-parameterization CNN reference.

baselines.name: ed
baselines.notes: Encoder-decoder style baseline from ClimSim; related to multi-step stable physics parameterization.

baselines.name: hsr
baselines.notes: Heteroskedastic regression baseline, tied to classical mean/variance prediction and aleatoric uncertainty modeling.
